scope: DuckDB UUID decoding in mixed multi-column and multi-row query results
contract: A UUID logical-type column decodes to Value::Uuid when other columns precede and follow it.
UUID-shaped VARCHAR remains Value::Text in the same result rows.
Typed UUID NULL remains Value::Null across multiple rows.

focused_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-duckdb --test integration value_contract_query_preserves_uuid_kinds_in_mixed_multirow_projection -- --test-threads=1
